summary: Iteration 9 — verified rk-1.1.0 change set: commonness display (personality primary factors show plain-English 'About 1 in 4' phrasing with no sten/x-of-10; globals carry a position label and remain excluded from population statements); report snapshotting (byte-identical PDFs and identical result JSON on repeat fetch); situation switch (PATCH /api/auth/me/situation swaps the snapshot key so a fresh fetch produces a different PDF, switching back returns the ORIGINAL bytes unchanged); Everyday Mirror end-to-end (start yields exactly 49 forced-choice items = 28 block-A + 21 block-B round-robin, kind='choice', 2 options, no shared response_scale; PUT /responses rejects dotted item ids with 400; side_map stable on session resume but random across sessions with identical item order; coherent completion produces 7 positions, priority list summing to 21 wins, developmental evidence_tier, pretest_status='not_run', 'map' key present, confidence label, validity block with zeta/side_bias_left_pct/undifferentiated_domains); Everyday PDF snapshotted byte-identical with 'not a compatibility score' refusal disclosure; Partners page renders all 8 data-testid sections + successful POST /api/partners/apply, 4th same-IP submission returns 429, invalid audience_where returns 400, footer-partners link visible on landing; Personality result UI shows 15 factor-commonness rows all with 'About x in y' phrasing (zero sten/x/10 leaks) and 5 global-provenance rows; Everyday Runner on 390px mobile shows exactly two large choice buttons (350×112px) with data-testid choice-option-1 / choice-option-2, no Likert (scale-option-* count = 0), keyboard '1' and '2' both advance while '5' does not, progress reads 'x of 49'; Everyday result renders 7 everyday-position-*, 7 everyday-priority-*, 5 everyday-cell-* (2 undifferentiated domains correctly excluded from the map), everyday-confidence, everyday-evidence-tier, everyday-cta-mirrors, and displays 'developmental', 'not a compatibility score', 'undifferentiated', 'How you choose'. Landing pricing still labels paid tiers 'NOT YET PURCHASABLE' with zero Buy/Checkout/Purchase buttons. Auth regressions: anon 401, cross-user result/PDF 403. Full backend regression 177/177 pytest passing (163 pre-existing + 14 new iteration_9).

critical_code_review_comments: routes/partners.py — clean, small, correct. Rate-limit query uses $or on {email, client_key} with a 24h window and MAX_PER_WINDOW=3, honouring the '3 per email OR forwarded address per 24h' rule from the spec. Consider adding a TTL index on partner_applications.submitted_at to auto-expire old rows once the founder-led phase ends.

services/narrative.py — snapshot keys (session_id, display_version, situation) for narratives and (session_id, kind, display_version, situation) for PDFs correctly balance immutability against the reader-controlled situation input. Bidirectional restore verified byte-identical — the previously-failing test_iteration5 case is well resolved.

services/everyday_scoring.py — zeta = 1 - 24d/336 formula, undifferentiated 2-2 handling, side bias, time floor, position×priority map exclusion of undifferentiated domains all observed on the wire. The 'silence is a valid output' behaviour (empty map when most domains are undifferentiated) is honest and correct.

routes/mirror_v2.py::put_responses — dotted-id rejection at line 367 (`'.' in r.item_id or r.item_id.startswith('$')`) is the right fix for the Mongo dotted-path silent-drop bug; combined with A1_1 renaming in the bank, Block A now stores correctly.

services/display.py — commonness.factors correctly excludes globals and stamps display_version='disp-1.0.0'. Row shape {display_version,sten,direction,share_pct,fraction,sentence} is minimal and consistent. Sentence never mentions 'sten' or 'x/10' — verified across all 15 primary factors.

Everyday PDF — required disclosures ('developmental', 'not a compatibility score', 'no band, no percentile, no norm', 'pretest') all present. The word 'compatibility' only surfaces inside the refusal wording — that IS the required output, not a violation.

Frontend Runner.js forced-choice branch — data-testid coverage is complete (choice-option-1/2, runner-item-statement, runner-progress), keyboard handler limited to '1' and '2' (verified: '5' key does not advance), option buttons are 350×112px on 390px mobile — genuinely large, single-tap friendly.

EverydayResult.js — 7 position rows with poles on either side + status label ('leaning planned', 'undifferentiated', 'clearly new' etc), priority bars, map cells (5 given 2 undifferentiated), confidence + evidence tier + 'How you choose' section all render correctly on desktop.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response uses `access_token` (not `token`). Everyday responses shape: PUT body is {responses:[{item_id,value:1|2}]}, values 1..2. Items[i].options is a list of two strings — side_map ordering is exposed only via options[0] text order, not a separate field. Everyday result priority is a LIST (not dict), positions is a dict, position×priority map key is 'map'. Partners rate limit ORs on email + client_key (X-Forwarded-For or peer IP) with MAX_PER_WINDOW=3 in a 24h window — use unique spoofed XFF headers to isolate test buckets from each other and from prior test runs. Everyday Runner intro screen has a 'Begin' button — click it before expecting choice-option-* to render. /take/everyday auto-routes to /results/{sid} once the user has a complete everyday session, so use a fresh user for runner UI tests. The refusal wording ('not a compatibility score', 'no band, no percentile, no norm') is REQUIRED product output — do not treat those keywords as banned when they appear inside disclosure sentences.
